display.purpose: The one word each stage owns. In the Hero: the name, always two lines. Mobile size clamp(84px, 24vw, 110px).

body.purpose: Reserved reading voice, loaded on <body> at weights 400/500. No size, leading or measure set on any surface yet.

descriptor.purpose: The one sentence above the display word. Sentence case, max 46ch, mute.

label.purpose: Navigation and the DZ mark only. The only uppercase role.

data.purpose: Commit hash and version. Sentence case, tabular numerals.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing. Used by the develop/settle load animation and the 200ms hover colour step.

motion.name: develop
motion.value: 1.6s var(--ease-out) both; from { filter: brightness(0.05) contrast(1.6) } to { filter: brightness(1) contrast(1) }
motion.purpose: The photograph rises once from near-black to its true tones on load. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: 1.6s var(--ease-out) both; from { transform: translateY(24px) } to { transform: none }
motion.purpose: The copy block (descriptor + name) settles up 24px into place alongside develop. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: hover-step
motion.purpose: Text links step from mute to pure white. Transition removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: portrait band crop, nav collapses to DZ + [ Talk ], leader and scroll cue hidden.

grain.implementation: Generated <canvas> white-noise greyscale field, regenerated on resize via ResizeObserver, static otherwise.
grain.note: Direction contract said ~10%; the build ships 0.14. Build wins.

photograph.grading: Left field and frame edges burned to #0b0b0b in the asset; no CSS vignette on desktop.
photograph.mobile: 66svh band, object-position: 78% 0, CSS veil linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11,11,11,0) 55%, rgba(11,11,11,1) 100%)

browserSurfaces.scrollbar: width 8px; track var(--bg); thumb var(--line); scrollbar-width: thin

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Top bar: DZ mark left, five bracketed stage links centred, right column empty on desktop.
components.html:
DZ
  • [ Build ]
  • [ Ship ]
  • [ Prove ]
  • [ Live ]

components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; padding: 28px clamp(20px, 4vw, 48px); background: var(--bg, #0b0b0b); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-list { display: flex; gap: 22px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--mute, #8f8d86); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ink, #efede8); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav-mark { color: var(--ink, #efede8) !important; font-weight: 500; justify-self: start; }

components.name: Bracketed Link
components.description: The only control: text typed in brackets, mute at rest, pure white on hover, no box.
components.css: .ds-bracket { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--mute, #8f8d86); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-bracket:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-bracket:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ink, #efede8); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Descriptor
components.description: The one mono sentence above the stage word.
components.html: Blockchain developer · ZK · privacy. I build systems that prove without revealing. Cali, Colombia.
components.css: .ds-descriptor { margin: 0; max-width: 46ch; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-weight: 400; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--mute, #8f8d86); text-wrap: pretty; }

components.name: Display Name
components.description: The stage word in Anton, two lines, each word a block.
components.css: .ds-name { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display, Anton, Impact, sans-serif); font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(96px, 13vw, 200px); line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: 0.005em; color: var(--ink, #efede8); text-wrap: balance; } .ds-name span { display: block; }

components.name: Commit Hash with Leader
components.description: 0x<sha> and version in mono, hairline underline when linked, 1px leader of gutter length to the stage edge.
components.css: .ds-hash { margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--mute, #8f8d86); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-hash a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #262624); transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-hash a:hover { color: #fff; border-color: #fff; } .ds-hash a:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ink, #efede8); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-hash::after { content: ''; width: clamp(20px, 4vw, 48px); height: 1px; background: var(--line, #262624); } .ds-hash-version { color: var(--mute, #8f8d86); }

components.name: Scroll Cue
components.description: 44x72 hit area with a 1px line fading from transparent to ink; links to the next stage.
components.css: .ds-cue { display: grid; justify-items: center; align-items: end; width: 44px; height: 72px; } .ds-cue span { width: 1px; height: 56px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, var(--ink, #efede8)); } .ds-cue:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ink, #efede8); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Hairline Rule
components.description: The only separator in the world: a 1px line in the hairline colour.

narrative.northStar: La Copia de Cámara Oscura (The Darkroom Print)
narrative.overview:
The site is a print pulled from a darkroom, not a web page with a photo on it. One person, one word, and everything else is darkness and grain. The photograph is the argument; the name is the caption; a real commit hash is the proof that the print was made. There is no color anywhere: the whole world lives between a near-black ground and a warm paper white, with a single grey for anything that speaks second and a hairline that is barely lighter than the ground. Depth comes from the photograph's own burned edges and a generated silver-gelatin grain, never from CSS gradients, glass, or shadows.

Density is extremely low and deliberate. A stage is a single viewport with a handful of elements, each anchored to an edge or a gutter, and large areas of ground left empty on purpose. Type does the work of hierarchy: a condensed heavy display face at poster scale against small, widely tracked monospace annotations. Body text in Archivo is loaded and reserved but has not yet appeared on a surface; the first stage is entirely display and mono.

Motion is a single event. On load the print "develops" once (1.6s, exponential ease-out) from near-black to its true tones while the caption settles into place; after that nothing moves except a 200ms colour step on hover. The resting state is complete without JavaScript and is shown immediately under prefers-reduced-motion. The product commits to six stages, one word each (Hero, Build, Ship, Prove, Live, Talk); every later stage inherits this world rather than opening a new one.
keyCharacteristics: Black and white only; no color accent exists in the token set.
One dark ground, one ink, one grey, one hairline; nothing in between.
Poster-scale condensed display name against 12–13px tracked monospace annotations.
Flat: no shadows, no CSS vignette on desktop, no radius; edges are the composition.
Generated grain over the whole stage (mix-blend-mode: overlay, opacity 0.14).

rules.name: The No-Accent Rule
rules.body: There is no fifth colour. Emphasis is produced by scale (display vs mono), by value (ink vs mute), or by state (mute → pure white), never by hue.

rules.name: The Burned-In Rule
rules.body: Darkness belongs to the photograph. Grading, vignette and the desktop left-field fade live in the raster; CSS carries no gradient on desktop. The one CSS fade (the mobile foot veil, linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 55%, ground 100%)) exists only where the portrait crop must land on solid ground.

rules.name: The One Word Rule
rules.body: Each stage owns exactly one display-scale word; everything else on the stage is 12–13px monospace. A stage with two display-scale elements has broken the world.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Is-Nav Rule
rules.body: Uppercase with 0.14em tracking is the navigation voice only. The descriptor and data lines stay in sentence case at 0.08em.

rules.name: The Flat Print Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, no backdrop-filter, no glass, no elevation states. If an element needs separation, it gets a 1px hairline ({colors.line}) or more empty ground, never a shadow.

rules.name: The Grain Is Material Rule
rules.body: The grain is one static field over the whole stage, regenerated only on resize. It is never animated, never tiled per element, and never applied to text alone.

dos: Do keep every stage to one display-scale word in Anton and 12–13px JetBrains Mono for everything else.
Do anchor elements to edges and the gutter (clamp(20px, 4vw, 48px)); leave the rest of the stage as ground.
Do use {colors.mute} for every secondary voice and {colors.line} for every 1px rule; use pure white only as a hover state.
Do put darkness into the raster (burn edges to #0b0b0b in the asset) and keep the grain canvas over the whole stage at opacity 0.14 with overlay blending.
Do ship the resting state complete without JavaScript, and disable the develop/settle animation under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do type controls as bracketed text ([ Word ]) with a 200ms colour step on hover and the global 1px ink focus outline.
donts: Don't introduce any hue: no accent colour, no tinted greys, no coloured links or focus rings.
Don't use box-shadow, backdrop-filter, glass, or CSS gradients on desktop; the only permitted gradient is the mobile foot veil and the 1px scroll cue.
Don't round any corner or draw any box around a control.
Don't cover the finger-on-lips gesture with text at any breakpoint.
Don't uppercase anything except navigation labels, and never track the descriptor or hash beyond 0.08em.
Don't animate anything after load except the 200ms hover colour step; the grain never moves.
